I remember shooting some oxymorphine a while ago...I think they were hexagonal or octagonal shaped (and i think they may have been orange or pink or something like that...besides white).  All I remember is that I did a few of them and remembered that it was way stronger and got my way higher than anything else.  Made Oxycontin look like Vikodin.  It was comparable to heroin or fenanyl.  I think the dosages were kind of the same as hydromorphone, but just had a way way better feeling.
I didn't have to cook it...I just added water, mixed up, and filtered.  Hope this helps
